#summary Video Tutorial on how to run the UNICASE client as a developer.

 <wiki:video url="http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bdiheu3oeLc"/>

This tutorial explains how to run UNICASE client as a developer. The version used is 0.5.2 which uses EMFStore in version 0.9.3.

In order to follow this tutorial, you need to check out the UNICASE plug-ins and run a local EMFStore server instance.

See:<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/CheckoutTutorial Checkout UNICASE code from SVN]<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/RunServerTutorial Run EMFStore Server as Developer]
